name: artifact-manager
description: Unified Cloudflare Worker for serving and administering HTML presentations from R2

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 SQLite database storing presentation metadata, visitor Basic Auth hashes, and administrator accounts

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket storing static HTML presentation files and assets under content/{slug}/

SESSION.description: KV namespace storing server-side administrator sessions and login rate-limit counters
